title: Config
description:
Config is the wire format of the wget behavioural configuration. It steers
both the wget input method (Wget/v1 in a component-constructor) and the wget
access resource repository (Wget/v1 access on an existing component version),
so descriptor authors and operators steer both paths through a single knob.

Example:

type: generic.config.ocm.software/v1
configurations:
- type: wget.config.ocm.software/v1alpha1
defaultChecksumPolicy:
onMissing: compute
sources:
- type: httpHeader
- type: externalUrl
algorithms: [sha256, sha1]
hosts:
"repo.example.com":
checksumPolicy:
onMissing: fail
sources: [{type: httpHeader}]

defaultChecksumPolicy.description:
DefaultChecksumPolicy is applied to every wget resource whose spec does
not carry its own checksumPolicy and whose host does not match a
[Config.Hosts] entry.

hosts.description:
Hosts maps hostname (or hostname:port) to per-host overrides. Entries
keyed by "host:port" win over bare-hostname entries, matching the
convention used by http.config.ocm.software.

ocm.software.open-component-model.bindin.title: Type
ocm.software.open-component-model.bindin.description: Type represents a structured type with an optional version and a name. It is used to identify the type of an object in a versioned API.

ocm.software.open-component-model.bindin.$comment: generated by the ocm schema generation tool
ocm.software.open-component-model.bindin.title: HostConfig
ocm.software.open-component-model.bindin.description:
HostConfig carries the per-host overrides. Every field is optional: unset
fields fall through to [Config.DefaultChecksumPolicy] (and then to nil, i.e.
compute without verification).

checksumPolicy.description:
ChecksumPolicy overrides [Config.DefaultChecksumPolicy] for every wget
URL whose host matches the map key this HostConfig is stored under.

ocm.software.open-component-model.bindin.$comment: generated by the ocm schema generation tool
ocm.software.open-component-model.bindin.title: ChecksumPolicy
ocm.software.open-component-model.bindin.description:
ChecksumPolicy is an ordered list of checksum sources evaluated first-match
wins, plus the behaviour when none yields a checksum. The digest recorded on
the resource is always SHA-256; a source may verify the transferred bytes
against a different algorithm (e.g. SHA-1 from a Maven repository) without
changing the stored algorithm.

onMissing.description:
OnMissing controls the behaviour when no source yields a checksum. Defaults
to "fail".

sources.description:
Sources are the checksum strategies to try, in order. The first that yields
an expected checksum is used to verify the download.

ocm.software.open-component-model.bindin.$comment: generated by the ocm schema generation tool
ocm.software.open-component-model.bindin.title: ChecksumSource
ocm.software.open-component-model.bindin.description:
ChecksumSource configures a single checksum-retrieval strategy within a
[ChecksumPolicy].

algorithms.description:
Algorithms restricts which checksum algorithms this source considers, given
as file extensions (sha256, sha512, sha1, md5), strongest-preferred first.
When empty, all supported algorithms are considered.

headers.description:
Headers lists additional response header names to inspect for httpHeader
sources, beyond the standard RFC 9530 and x-checksum-* headers. The
algorithm is inferred from a trailing token (e.g. "x-my-sha256").

url.description:
URL is the absolute URL of the checksum resource for externalUrl sources.
Empty falls back to `<artifact URL>.<ext>` (Maven's convention). One URL
per source: to cover multiple algorithms or hosts, add multiple sources.

ocm.software.open-component-model.bindin.$comment: generated by the ocm schema generation tool
ocm.software.open-component-model.bindin.title: ChecksumSourceType
ocm.software.open-component-model.bindin.description:
ChecksumSourceType selects a strategy for obtaining an expected checksum,
modelled on Maven's expected-checksum strategies.

oneOf.description:
ChecksumSourceHTTPHeader reads the checksum from the download response
headers ("Remote Included"): the RFC 9530 Content-Digest field and the
non-standard x-checksum-* family.

ChecksumSourceExternalURL fetches the checksum from a sibling URL
("Remote External"), e.g. <url>.sha256.

ChecksumSourceStream computes the digest from the downloaded stream without
an external expected checksum.

ocm.software.open-component-model.bindin.$comment: generated by the ocm schema generation tool
ocm.software.open-component-model.bindin.title: OnMissingChecksum
ocm.software.open-component-model.bindin.description:
OnMissingChecksum controls what happens when a [ChecksumPolicy] is configured
but none of its sources yields an expected checksum.

oneOf.description:
OnMissingFail aborts the input with an error when no source yields a checksum.
This is the default when a ChecksumPolicy is set.

OnMissingCompute falls back to computing the digest from the stream without
external verification when no source yields a checksum.
